fusions.name: Trail Chop
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 5 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the maximum range of 5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% per 100 paces run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Heel Drop
fusions.desc: Brings the haft down hard, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. You move 20% faster for 12 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Well-Trodden
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage and your other abilities' cooldowns are 6% shorter.
